newsitem.title: USA: Sears, Roebuck to redeem 8.88 pct preferred.
newsitem.headline: Sears, Roebuck to redeem 8.88 pct preferred.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Monday it will redeem all of its outstanding 8.88 percent preferred shares, first series, on November 12.
Redemption of the preferred shares will result in the simultaneous redemption of the 13,000,000 depositary shares, each representing one-fourth of a preferred share.

Each holder of record of depositary shares will receive on the redemption date, in exchange for each depositary share, a cash payment of $25 plus $0.2525. This represents accrued and unpaid dividends up to, but not including, the redemption date for a total cash payment of $25.2525 per share.
